notes.title: MIMPI DLC "LUNAPARK" IN DEVELOPMENT
notes.notes:
Woof, folks! We're proud to announce that a long-awaited new episode of Mimpi Dreams is finally happening. It's still a little bit early for us to estimate a date of release, but we're working hard to get there as soon as possible. The new episode will  feature new world, new story and characters, new puzzles and minigames. All designed to either test your brain or simply make you laugh. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Large update and a new episode!
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/5d9OlJrbtW0

Mimpi finally comes back! We are happy to announce the release of a large game update and a gigantic new level Mars that is larger than all other levels together. 

This free update features:
[list][*]switch to Free2Play model, with premium DLCs
[*]premium DLC: new episode „Mars“
[*]new costumes for Mimpi
[*]improvements in all game levels
[*]new sounds and music[/list]
We hope that you will enjoy the free content and also the long-awaited new level, which could be easily nicknamed „Mimpi Dreams 2.“ 

Please let us know how do you like it.  We are already working on a new one. 

The Team of Mimpi Dreams
Dreadlocks Mobile

notes.title: MIMPI DREAMS IS GOING TO SWITCH TO FREE 2 PLAY
notes.notes:
Dear players,

at the occasion of publishing long-awaited game update we decided to switch Mimpi Dreams from Premium to Free 2 Play. 

This will allow you to download the game and play all of the initial levels for free, without any restriction. 

New levels that weren’t part of the initial release (Factory, Mars, and levels that we will develop in future), are going to be distributed as premium DLC. 

If you have already purchased Mimpi Dreams before this change you will automatically receive Factory DLC for free, which means that this level will remain unlocked in the game menu.   

We hope this change will make Mimpi Dreams available to everyone and that it will allow us to make new levels more often.

The team of Mimpi Dreams
Dreadlocks Mobile

notes.title: Mimpi Dreams Free OST!
notes.notes:
So do you want to listen to the game Soundtrack?

Just head out to the OST DLC page (http://store.steampowered.com/app/459110/) and add it to your account for free! 

After that you can find the OST in the game folder at: Steam>steamapps>common>Mimpi Dreams> Mimpi_Dreams_OST

Hope you enjoy it! ːCuriousMimpiː

notes.title: Celebrate Easter with Mimpi in Mimpi Dreams!
notes.notes:
Celebrate Easter with Mimpi and find all the hidden Easter eggs in the levels!

Each level has a hidden Easter egg that you need to find in order to get the an achievement, also if you will get a new skin for Mimpi!

You can only find these Easter eggs on the next Sunday and Monday (March 27 and 28)

So get out there and find all of the Easter eggs! Good luck! ːCuriousMimpiː
